verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an inference API provider, and such a service could plausibly offer registrable webhooks, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. The docs cover only OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible request/response APIs, streaming, tool calls, and console key management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
